statement.p: Find the slope of the line.

solution.p: To find the slope of a line from its graph, we first need to identify two points that the line passes through. It is wise to choose points with integer coordinates. For this problem, we choose {\left(0, 2\right)} and {\left(8, 5\right)}\text{.}
Next, we sketch a slope triangle and find the rise and run. In the sketch below, the rise is 3 and the run is 8\text{.}
